'''Livien''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and the founding world of the [[Livien League]].<ref name="Xim Week" />

==History==
The planet was absorbed into [[Xim's empire|Xim's Empire]] as [[Xim/Legends|he]] expanded his borders from the [[Kingdom of Cron]], conquering the worlds of the [[Livien League]].

Livien was neutral during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], but ruled by a tyrannical [[House of Tion/Legends|royal family]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was secretly backing rebel factions against them with military shipments.<ref name="Tyrants">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Overthrowing the Tyrants}}</ref> Shortly afterwards, Livien's [[Livien Finance Minister|incumbent]] [[Finance Minister]] stole millions of [[Credit chip/Legends|credits]] and went into hiding.<ref name="FinanceMinister">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Take the Money and Run}}</ref>

By the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Livien had lost any prominence it once held, becoming a subsistence agriculture world pockmarked with ancient ruins.<ref name="Xim Week" />
